params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch --prune origin; $protected=@('main','heaven-bridge'); $branches=@('fix/release-classifier-workflow-scope-20260929','feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928','agent/liveness-scheduler-machine-policy-20260929','agent/agent-control-federation-heartbeat-20260929','feature/agent-control-panel-20260928','agent/game-profile-id-containment-v8.8.5-reconcile','ui/frontend-responsive-polish-20260928','release/v8.8.5-20260929','agent/smart-pack-planner-core','integration/smart-pack-planner-main-20260929','integration/smart-pack-planner-main-r2-20260929','support/updater-publication-input-scope-20260928','agent/archive-streaming-budget-20260928','agent/support-bundle-share-safety-20260928','agent/support-auto-updater-release-security-audit-20260928','agent/replacefilew-failure-characterization-20260927','agent/replacefilew-failure-characterization-v2','agent/windows-live-containment-hardening','agent/windows-live-containment-hardening-v2','agent/support-updater-binary-asset-accept-20260928'); $deleted=@(); $missing=@(); foreach($b in $branches){ if($protected -contains $b){ throw "PROTECTED_BRANCH_IN_DELETE_SET:$b" }; $hit=git ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$b"; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "LSREMOTE_FAILED:$b" }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(($hit -join ''))){ $missing += $b; continue }; git push origin --delete $b; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "DELETE_FAILED:$b" }; $deleted += $b }; Write-Output ("DELETED="+($deleted -join ',')); Write-Output ("ALREADY_MISSING="+($missing -join ',')); $remaining=(git ls-remote --heads origin | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[1] -replace '^refs/heads/','' } | Sort-Object); Write-Output ("REMAINING_COUNT="+$remaining.Count); $remaining | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ("BRANCH="+$_) }
